ablation.notes: Phase 4D: 2-Level Haar DWT lowpass for endpoint AdaIN. LL_2 (8x8) locked = absolute composition; LH_2/HL_2/HH_2 (8x8) released for macro-strokes; LH_1/HL_1/HH_1 (16x16) for micro-noise. User scheme 2: cascade decomposition.
